'''''Protector''''' was a [[Victory II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory II''-class Star Destroyer]] in the service of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and later the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].

==History==
===Galactic Civil War===
The ''Protector'' attempted and [[Battle of Sullust (4 ABY)|failed to stop]] the Mon Calamari Cruiser [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']] from rendezvousing with the rest of the Rebel fleet at Sullust just before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

This ship survived the Battle of Endor and later became one of the ships under the command of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]].<ref name="CSWE" />

===Yuuzhan Vong War===
In [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]], following the starfleet's failure at the [[Battle of Bastion]] and its subsequent tactical withdrawal from [[Yaga Minor/Legends|Yaga Minor]], forces were amassed at the planet [[Borosk/Legends|Borosk]] for a defense against the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invaders. During the [[Battle of Borosk (Yuuzhan Vong War)|battle]] that ensued, ''Protector'' was tasked with leading [[Fleet Group Protector|Fleet Group ''Protector'']], one of four temporary battlegroups created for the planet's defense.

Following the battle, ''Protector'' was among the Star Destroyers ordered deployed to assist in the [[Battle of Yaga Minor (Yuuzhan Vong War)|defense of Yaga Minor]].

==Behind the scenes==
In [[2008]], ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' stated there were three different [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Victory-class Star Destroyers]] called ''Protector'' in the [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]]. Two were used by the Empire : this one and an [[Protector (Victory I-class)|other]], [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Harkov]].

''The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia'' also identified the Imperial Remnant's ''Protector'' from ''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant]]'' as the same ship.
